instruction: Follow all artists of all reggae-genre songs in any of my playlists on Spotify.
notes: Single-app (spotify) task with no answer. Knowledge flow: show_profile -> (profile-known) gives the login username; show_account_passwords -> (passwords-known); login -> (has-token spotify ?t); show_playlist_library -> (library-shown) exposes the ids of playlists marked (in-library ?p) (the agent must page through all results); show_playlist ?p -> (playlist-shown ?p) exposes ids of songs (in-playlist ?s ?p); show_song ?s -> (song-shown ?s) exposes the genre and artist ids (show_song takes no token; the extra ?p parameter just records which shown playlist the song came from). follow_artist is only enabled for an artist of a shown song whose genre is the domain constant reggae and who is not yet followed, matching the evaluation (added UserArtistFollowing rows == artists of reggae songs in any playlist, nothing removed). Because STRIPS cannot express an all-target-artists-followed goal without quantification, the number of artists still to follow is encoded as discrete count objects (count-2 -> count-1 -> count-0) decremented by each follow; (remaining-to-follow count-0) is the single goal condition checked by supervisor-complete-task, and the explicit (following artist-1)/(following artist-3) goal atoms are logically entailed by it. The hidden world facts (which songs are in which playlist, their genres and artists) are given in :init as static truths so the planner can reason; a real agent discovers them through the lookup calls and must call show_song for every song in every playlist (the reference plan includes show_song for the non-reggae song-2 even though an optimal planner may skip it). Instance: 2 playlists, 3 songs (song-1 reggae/artist-1, song-2 pop/artist-2, song-3 reggae/artist-3); targets are artist-1 and artist-3.
